note: Adapted from the species description in Mjöberg (1920); the original is in English; soldier, worker and queen are all treated, with no alate description; measurements are those given clearly in the text; figure numbers, place names and nesting records are omitted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Closely related to M. alleni, recognizable in lateral view by the very long and narrow head and the rather large, pointed frontal projection, the tip of which is more upturned than in M. alleni. Some soldiers from nests in trees near Laura differ slightly in lateral view: frontal projection straighter, head slightly lower posteriorly and slightly more concave medially, anterior angles of labrum rounded.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Body white, slender; head pale yellow; mandibles black. Head very long, more than one and a half times as long as wide, sides parallel, posterior part slightly rounded; midline and upper surface of the frontal projection paler; frontal projection very large and pointed, densely hairy, upper edge darker; labrum very small, sides parallel, anterior margin truncate, only the anteriormost angles slightly projecting; mandibles very long, slightly curved, base of the left mandibular tooth very broad, distal part cylindrical; antennae 14-segmented, slender, segment 3 broadest medially and longer than segment 2, segment 4 shorter than segment 3, segments 5 and 6 as long as segment 3, becoming gradually longer thereafter, segment 8 and the following several segments longest, more than twice as long as wide, the two apical segments long and slender, longer than segment 12; pronotum ridged, strongly narrowed on both sides; abdomen very long and narrow. Body length with mandibles 6 mm, head length with mandibles 3.7 mm, head width 1.06 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: White, head pale yellow, paler anteriorly. Head round, widest anteriorly; base of postclypeus oval, densely covered with many small dark spots; mandibular dentition similar to that described for the worker of M. harrisi; antennae 14-segmented, basal segments about twice as long as segment 2, segments 3 and 4 very short, segment 5 short and much wider than long, segments from segment 6 onward gradually longer, but only the apical segment attaining twice its width; pronotum small, sides rounded; abdomen long and narrow. Body length 4 mm, head length 0.99 mm, head width 0.82 mm.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Queen: head and thorax pale brown, abdomen white, with 8 very narrow and short sclerotized plates. Head small, posterior part and sides rounded, anterior part deeply concave; compound eyes with coarse facets but not very prominent; ocelli large, crescent-shaped; fontanelle a small narrow strip, widest posteriorly, narrowing anteriorly; base of postclypeus divided by a median suture, anterior margin truncate; labrum broad, anterior margin rounded; mandibular dentition similar to that of M. harrisi; antennae dark brown, segment 3 very short, narrower than the surrounding segments, subsequently gradually longer; pronotum much wider than long, with a very shallow median line anteriorly, sides gradually narrowed, posterior margin concave, densely hairy. Body length 18 mm, head length 0.8 mm, head width 0.84 mm.
